rule: Advance a movement family one rung only after 3 clean exposures at the current rung (pain <= 2/10, no next-morning stiffness rise)
summary: Criteria-based, symptom-guided progression is consensus practice in return to sport (Bern 2016; Silbernagel & Crossley), but no study tests a specific number of clean exposures before progressing a strength movement. Three is a conservative coaching heuristic; at 1-2 gated sessions/week it rarely binds more than the 14-day minimum. Evidence supports the direction (criteria + symptom response), not the number.

sources.note: 2016 Bern RTS consensus: return to sport is a graded continuum and a risk-management decision, not a single end-point
Silbernagel & Crossley 2015: criteria- and symptom-guided staged return to sport; recurrence risk is highest in the return phase
Delaware-Oslo ACL cohort: both time (each month of delay to 9 mo cut reinjury 51%) and passing function criteria lowered reinjury: time AND criteria both matter
2022 Bern shoulder consensus (Delphi): principle-based load/risk management; no high-quality evidence for specific RTS criteria
